title: Factorized layer x task ReFT codes with held-out combinations
hypothesis: A rank-2 layer-factor x task-factor hidden-intervention code will predict all eight held-out layer/task combinations at relative function-output RMSE <=0.05 when target coefficients are generated by a matching rank-2 interaction, using <=0.5x the actual payload of a dense shared-basis per-pair code table.
physical_object: One frozen identity hidden map and one shared rank-four representation-intervention basis for four logical layers and eight tasks.
mirror_coordinate: For each basis mode k, m_(layer,task,k)=sum_q a_(layer,k,q)*b_(task,k,q), with factor rank q=2.
logical_multiplicity: 32 explicit layer/task functions, including eight layer/task pairs withheld from all shared-code fitting and tested on held-out inputs.
controls: native rank-2 bilinear layer/task coefficient factorization with exactly matched equation and parameter count
dense shared-basis coefficient table fit only on visible pairs and zero-filled on held-out pairs
additive layer plus task main-effect coefficients
full-matrix oracle upper with every held-out intervention paid

task.type: synthetic hidden-state regression over crossed layer/task functions
task.heldout_mask: (layer_id + task_id) mod 4 == 0 (8 held-out pairs; remaining 24 visible)
task.target: Delta_(l,t)=U diag(M_(l,t,:)) V^T; M_(l,t,k)=sum_q A_(l,k,q)B_(t,k,q) + rho*epsilon_(l,t,k), where epsilon is pair-private noise with std matched to the shared code scale.
task.primary_metric: held-out pair relative output RMSE normalized by target intervention RMS
secondary_metrics: factor fitting updates and wall time

development.optimizer: Adam lr .03 for 3000 fixed steps; no early stopping or seed-specific selection
development.hyperparameter_changes_after_run: prohibited absent a numbered amendment; source locked first

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if rho=0 held-out quality/storage gate passes and factorized Mirror has a distinct useful margin over the equation-matched native bilinear control.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all layer and task factors or dense pair codes
per-pair factors or full oracle matrices

compute.proxy: shared basis projection plus code generation (2*D*K + K*factor_rank); full matrix D*D

gates.PROMISING: Both seeds at rho=0: held-out relative output RMSE <=0.05, unique predicted held-out functions, factorized payload <=0.50x dense code-table payload, and valid full-matrix replay. Native-control attribution is a separate required condition.
gates.FAIL: Upper/replay is valid but held-out quality or byte gate misses, or native bilinear factorization exactly explains the result without Mirror-specific gain.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Full-matrix upper or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Aligned synthetic crossed functions and one private-noise perturbation only; no trained Transformer or behavioral/NLL claim.
Held-out pair target deltas are never used to fit basis, factors, gates or hyperparameters.
No unobserved combinations beyond the eight explicitly evaluated held-out pairs count as logical functions.
The equation-matched native bilinear factorization is mandatory; generic factorization savings are not Mirror-specific.
